reviews.comment:
Muy inaccesible para poder acceder a la estación y ni hablar si se viene para el lado de capital hay que hacerlas de dies km para ingresar y otra opción es subir por acceso a Colón y por una colectora imposible de transitar, vergüenza que una institución como el ACA no tome medidas

(Translated by Google)
Very inaccessible to reach the station, and even more so if you're coming from the capital; you have to drive ten kilometers to get there, and another option is to go up via the access road to Colón and then along a service road that's impossible to navigate. It's shameful that an institution like the ACA doesn't take action.

reviews.comment:
